forecast_classification.disclaimer_en: Experimental forecast: generated from the active synthetic demonstration dataset by a simple explainable trend model. It is not an official projection and has not been validated against real-world outcomes.

evaluation.reason: Holdout metrics are computed offline by backend/src/scripts/generate-forecasts.ts and are not stored in the application schema; no live R² is claimed.
